facts.fact: The Somalia National Bureau of Statistics unveiled the Second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS 2, 2024-2029 per the document's header note) on 2025-12-07, building on the first NSDS.

The first NSDS was in effect from 2017 to 2023, developed under the Directorate of Statistics in the Ministry of Planning, Investment and Economic Development; it has ended and been succeeded by NSDS 2.

systems.owner: Ministry of Planning, Investment and Economic Development (Directorate of Statistics)

note: Regional strategy RSDS II 2026-2030 adopted; states nothing of this country's national strategy.

facts.fact: PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2024-2029.
